Class MethodPulsarListenerEndpoint<V>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.pulsar.spring.config.AbstractPulsarListenerEndpoint<V>
org.apache.pulsar.spring.config.MethodPulsarListenerEndpoint<V>
Type Parameters:
V - Message payload type
All Implemented Interfaces:
ListenerEndpoint<PulsarMessageListenerContainer>, PulsarListenerEndpoint, Aware, BeanFactoryAware, InitializingBean
public class MethodPulsarListenerEndpoint<V> extends AbstractPulsarListenerEndpoint<V>
A PulsarListenerEndpoint providing the method to invoke to process an incoming message for this endpoint.
Author:
Soby Chacko, Alexander Preuß, Chris Bono, Jihoon Kim

    • setTrustedPackages

      public void setTrustedPackages(String... trustedPackages)
      Add packages to trust for header deserialization. Trust is by exact package match; sub-packages are not trusted transitively. The given packages are added to JsonPulsarHeaderMapper.DEFAULT_TRUSTED_PACKAGES, which are always included. Pass "*" as the sole entry to trust all packages (not recommended for untrusted message sources).
      Parameters:
      trustedPackages - packages to add to the trusted list for header deserialization
